lines.text: We already caught up today, {player}. Come by tomorrow.
I think I've told you everything I know for one day.
You'll wear my voice out. Tomorrow, all right?
Again? Ha! I like you, but I'm out of stories till tomorrow!
I've talked myself hoarse. Train with me tomorrow instead!
We have spoken enough for one day. Go and do something useful with it.
I said what I had to say. Repetition doesn't improve it.
